title: SDR daily notes - quick hits and follow-ups
content:
TODAY (2026-03-25) — sprint plan and scratchpad

Daily goals:
- Outbound dials: 40 (aim for 25 by noon)
- New discovery meetings: 3
- Logged activity in CRM with 'likely-deploy' tag and product_interest field (hosted/dedicated/private)
- Follow-up emails sent: 15

AM BLOCK (9:00–12:00) — high intent list
1) Veridian Health — Maya Torres (CTO) — 9:15am call (voicemail yesterday)
   - Notes: concerned about PHI + latency; mentioned FedRAMP.
   - Play: lead with Private (VPC/on-prem) options + audit logs. Send case study: "Redwood Private — healthcare deploy".
   - Next step: email w/one-pager + request for compliance contact. CRN: CRM-7902.

2) Cartera Analytics — R. Singh (Head of Data) — 10:05am
   - Notes: currently using self-hosted Triton, complaining about unpredictable token costs. Wants cost-per-inference estimates.
   - Play: Redwood Optimize + batching examples; offer cost model calc w/ their 24/7 traffic profile.
   - Next step: ask for sample traffic (QPS + avg seq length). Book discovery if they share traffic.

3) Lumen Retail — Jenna Park (Product PM) — cold call -> demo request
   - Notes: interested in embeddings for product search.
   - Play: demo hosted embeddings (fast start) then suggest Dedicated for scale.
   - Next: send embed comparator + invite to weekly embed office hours.

MIDDAY (12:30–15:30) — follow-ups & nurture
- Follow-up template to send (short):
  Subject: Quick follow on Redwood inference options
  Body: Hey {first}, quick note — I can share a cost/latency snapshot for your usage. If you’re evaluating private deployment we have an on-prem checklist. Free to sync 20m this week? — Sam

- Quick list to email: CRM-1678, CRM-1741, CRM-1824 (notes: all demo attendees last month)

Afternoon tasks (15:30–17:30):
- Log call outcomes in CRM (important: set field 'deployment_interest' = hosted/dedicated/private).
- Touch top 10 warm leads from last week's Demo Day. Prioritize: those who asked about SLA or quantization.
- Slack DM AE (Priya) for intro to Cloud Security lead at Veridian.

Snippets / elevator pitches I used today:
- Quick opener (tech): "We help teams run inference at predictable latency and unit economics across hosted, reserved, or private deployments — so you don't have to trade accuracy for cost."
- For procurement: "Dedicated capacity can be committed monthly/annually to lock predictable throughput and lower per-token spend."
- For security-conscious buyers: "Private deploy gives you customer-controlled VPC, KMS/HSM integration, and audit logs for compliance."

Cold email subject variations to A/B test:
- "Latency & cost drops for your LLM pipelines"
- "Private inference option for PHI workloads"
- "Quick cost snapshot for your model usage"

Call outcomes (quick log):
- Veridian Health: left vm, +1 (warm). Action: send one-pager + ask compliance contact (due 2026-03-27).
- Cartera Analytics: interested, needs traffic. Action: follow-up email requesting sample (due 2026-03-26).
- Lumen Retail: demo requested. Action: schedule demo with DevRel (Ethan) — tentative 2026-03-30.
- Pilot Co (warm): asked about canary rollouts and automatic fallbacks. Sent docs link.

Pipeline watchlist (manual triage) — critical next steps:
- CRM-2123 (finance fintech) — legal already flagged data residency; push Private/On-prem playbook.
- CRM-1987 (SaaS marketplace) — needs scale test; propose Dedicated reserved pool + autoscale policy trial.
- CRM-2011 (marketplace) — embed latency SLA required; recommend model variant routing + fallback.

Questions / asks for reps & SEs:
- Priya: can you share the 1-pager comparing Dedicated vs Private for compliance checklists? (Slack pinged)
- Ethan (DevRel): need a quick demo script for embeddings -> show latency + top-k accuracy examples.

Things to log after each call:
- Tokens estimate (if provided)
- Preferred deployment (hosted/dedicated/private)
- Any compliance keywords (HIPAA, FedRAMP, SOC2)
- Budget signals ("we have $X/month")

Personal TODOs (micro):
- Refill water bottle (lol)
- 2pm: standup w/SDR team (sync pipeline)
- End of day: create shortlist of 8 follow-ups to escalate to AE (tag: "push-to-AE")

Random notes / brainstorms:
- Idea: quick "cost snapshot" script we can run from SDR side to give immediate $/month estimate for Hosted vs Dedicated given QPS and avg seq len — ask product for simple calc or sheet (link to ask: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/GTMS/INF+-+Cost+Snapshot+Req).
- Draft subject for nurture drip about model quantization wins: "2x throughput with minimal quality impact" — use in next week's sequence.

End-of-day checklist:
[ ] CRM logged for all 40 dials
[ ] 15 follow-ups sent
[ ] 3 discovery meetings booked or rescheduled

Notes to self: keep emails concise, reference a concrete next step (e.g., "share traffic sample"), and always add an extra sentence about cost predictability — it's been resonating this quarter.

---
Metadata quick log (for later migration):
- Related playbook: INF - Quick Playbook (Confluence)
- Jira tasks to follow: SALESACT-234 (demo materials), SALESACT-245 (cost calc sheet)

End.
